tasks.short: Group shop orders to improve material use and reduce setup changes.

steps.what: Review actual shop orders, stock availability, due dates and current machine setup
Specify feasible material, tooling, machine and delivery constraints for grouping the orders
Sort shop orders into candidate groups under explicit material and setup objectives
outputs: candidate order groups and stated tradeoffs

steps.what: Resolve actual exceptions and check final groups, material utilisation and setup implications
inputs: candidate order groups and stated tradeoffs

steps.what: Commit the checked final order groups to the shop planning record

tasks.design: Test native grouping and scheduling constraints in {OPS_SYSTEM} before a custom solver. Generate candidate groups only from separately checked actual orders, material and setup constraints; keep exception resolution and final plan writing/checking human and commit the final grouping separately without starting machines.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trying compatible groups repeatedly by hand can obscure setup and material tradeoffs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native deterministic grouping can compare explicit constraints and objectives without judging unrecorded shop conditions.
tasks.still_hard: Urgent jobs, actual stock condition and tooling changes can invalidate a nominally efficient group.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer resolves real production tradeoffs that explicit constraints do not capture.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated grouping; production priority authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native manufacturing scheduling can group orders against explicit material, tooling and setup constraints.

assumptions: Boundary is grouping shop orders and recording the selected plan, not physical setup, material handling or machine execution.

Planning supplies order IDs, quantities, due dates and material requirements; stock records and actual setup checks supply available material and current tooling. The programmer verifies these in s1 and captures machine compatibility, sequence restrictions and objective priorities in s2. Missing constraints require manual grouping and checking.
Shares and reduction are provisional. Native configuration comes first; existing automatic scheduling and runtime earn no new saving.
Final plan composition and accuracy checking are actual s4 work, not added approval ceremony. The fully retained 1 percent commit is schema granularity.
unknowns: Completeness of setup and material constraints
research_questions: Do native group candidates remain feasible against actual shop conditions and existing priorities?

incremental.description: Maintain grouping constraints and investigate infeasible candidate patterns

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final shop order groups and source constraint snapshot

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated candidate grouping saves 25 points minus two upkeep = 23. Half eligible grouping gives 10.5. Actual input checking, constraint capture, final exception resolution and commit retain full effort. No material or setup-time outcome is claimed as labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify encoded machining instructions against original part specifications and drawings.

steps.what: Verify original part revisions, encoded program identity and actual tooling and stock definitions
Set up the program and source geometry in the native verification environment
Compare encoded instruction geometry against original part geometry using native simulation
outputs: source-linked geometry differences and simulation findings

steps.what: Inspect comparison findings and verify instruction accuracy, tolerances, collisions and unsupported program behaviour
inputs: source-linked geometry differences and simulation findings

steps.what: Write and check actual verification findings, limitations and program revision references
inputs: source-linked geometry differences and simulation findings

steps.what: Save the checked actual program verification note

tasks.design: Use native revision-matched imports and simulation comparison in {OTHER}, the CAM verification application, before custom analysis. Retain actual specification checks and complete interpretation of geometry, collision and unsupported-code findings; separately save actual verification conclusions in {DOCS} without releasing a program to a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual encoded-coordinate and geometry comparison can repeat work already expressible in a native verifier.
tasks.enabler_now: Native simulation can compare explicit geometry and motions, provided the actual setup and program are represented.
tasks.still_hard: Unsupported codes, incorrect fixtures or missing tolerance requirements can invalidate a clean simulation.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer knows what the simulation does not represent and checks actual instruction intent.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometric comparison; program release and actual machining remain separate authority.

evidence.claim: Siemens describes CAM output requiring programmer validation and simulation before NC code runs; this supports retaining actual verification and a release boundary.
Model knowledge: native program-to-part geometry comparison can replace repeated manual coordinate comparison when the verifier supports the actual code and setup.

assumptions: Boundary is comparing encoded instructions with original specifications and documenting the finding, not machine transfer, release or first-article execution.

Design supplies source geometry, drawing revision and tolerances; programming supplies exact NC version and machine/postprocessor context. The programmer captures and checks stock, fixtures, tools and supported code in s1-s2. Missing setup or unsupported code returns to manual verification.

The provisional saving applies to actual manual coordinate comparison in s3, not simulation runtime. If native simulation already performs that comparison, no new saving is claimed. Final interpretation remains full effort.
The existing final note accuracy check covers its separate fully retained 1 percent save, which is schema granularity.
unknowns: Actual representation of fixtures and controller-specific code
research_questions: Does a supported verifier reproduce independently checked geometry and known collision or code exceptions?

incremental.description: Maintain verified setup imports and inspect unsupported-code exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked actual instruction verification note bound to NC source and setup revisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native setup reuse saves five points and exact manual geometry comparison saves 25: 30 minus two upkeep = 28. Half eligible comparison and setup benefit gives 13. Input verification, findings interpretation, actual writing and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare geometric layouts from graphic displays using drafting tools.

steps.what: Interpret source graphic displays and determine the required geometric construction and dimensions
Construct geometric layouts using native CAD projection, dimensions and reusable geometric elements
Check actual geometry, coordinate origin, units and dimensional completeness against source requirements
Write and check actual layout annotations, references and revision details
Save the checked final geometric layout

tasks.design: Configure native projection, dimensioning and geometric libraries in {OTHER}, the CAD application, for the programmers chosen construction. Keep source interpretation, actual geometry checks and annotation writing human; save the checked layout separately without creating or running machine instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated geometric construction can be drawn manually despite reusable source geometry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD operations can repeat exact geometry while preserving human construction choices.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong source interpretation, units or coordinate origins can make a precise drawing wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer understands which geometric relationships the actual part requires.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drafting; construction judgement and programming authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD tools support geometric projections, dimensions and reusable exact geometric elements.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing geometric layouts, not generating NC programs or machining parts.

The designer supplies source graphic displays and dimensions. The programmer verifies required construction, units, origin and source revision in s1 and enters missing geometric parameters in s2 retained time. No geometry is inferred from an unavailable file.
Native operations are tested first. Shares and reduction are provisional for actual repeated drafting; existing CAD runtime and already-used functions earn no saving.
Actual annotation writing and accuracy checks remain full effort; the fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity and adds no approval ceremony.
research_questions: Can native projection and libraries reduce actual drafting while preserving independently checked geometry?

incremental.description: Maintain geometric library units and source-version mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final annotated geometric layout and source revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 45-unit repetitive drafting step retains 40 percent, saving 27 points minus one upkeep = 26. Half eligible drafting gives 12.5. Actual construction interpretation, checks, annotations and save remain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order the correct tooling for actual machining jobs.

steps.what: Review actual job operations and determine required tooling specifications and quantities
Check actual tool stock and exact available supplier catalogue items
Select actual tooling and verify compatibility, lead time, supplier terms and purchase authority
Prepare the tooling order using exact checked item, quantity, price and delivery fields
Review and authorise the complete final tooling order and supplier destination
Send the authorised final tooling order to the selected supplier
Verify actual supplier acceptance and resolve changed availability or order terms
Write and check actual tooling order status, supplier evidence and job reference
Commit the checked actual tooling order record

tasks.design: Use native exact-item stock and catalogue views in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{PROCUREMENT}, followed by native order field reuse. Keep tool selection, compatibility and spending checks human; send the complete authorised order separately, verify actual supplier response and separately write and commit actual status without calling an order a received tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact tooling fields may be searched and re-entered after actual selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue selection and purchase forms can reuse checked item fields without choosing substitute tooling.
tasks.still_hard: Tool-machine compatibility, actual availability and changed terms need professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer knows whether the exact tool suits the actual machining operation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated lookup and entry; purchase and tooling authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement forms can reuse exact catalogue item and order fields while retaining human tooling choice and purchase authorisation.

assumptions: Boundary is ordering tooling through verified actual supplier status, not receiving tools or setting up a machine. This scenario assumes existing delegated purchase authority; existing additional purchasing signers must be retained if required, with their labour separately owned.

The programmer captures actual tool specification and quantity in s1, verifies exact stock/catalogue matches in s2 and selects item ID, supplier, price, currency, delivery requirement and job reference in s3. Missing or ambiguous items require manual entry and checking in retained s4 time.

Actual supplier response is external returned evidence, not inferred from submission. Changed final terms require fresh approval before a new send; unresolved orders remain unresolved in the status record.

Shares and reductions are provisional. Native configuration precedes custom code; existing views, populated forms and runtime earn no new benefit. The two fully retained 1 percent actions are schema granularity.
research_questions: Can native forms preserve exact tooling identifiers and job references without unsupported substitutes?

incremental.description: Check catalogue-unit mappings and inspect failed field reuse

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final authorised tooling order with exact supplier items quantities price and destination
s8 complete checked actual tooling order status and supplier response reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional lookup saves five points and exact order field preparation saves 12: 17 minus 1.5 upkeep = 15.5. Half eligible lookup and entry benefit gives seven. Requirements, selection, authorisation, send, actual acceptance checks, actual status writing and commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
